rebuttal_or_critique: I maintain my position that the current policy stance must remain one of withdrawal of accommodation. While I acknowledge the moderation in core inflation to 3.10%, the headline CPI at 4.75% remains uncomfortably above our 4.00% target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.69% is not merely a supply-side nuisance; it carries the risk of becoming embedded in inflation expectations, particularly given the positive output gap of 0.40%. Monetary policy credibility is built on the consistency of our actions; shifting the stance to neutral while headline inflation is still significantly above target would be premature and could necessitate a more aggressive policy response later. We must ensure that the disinflationary process is durable and not subject to reversal. I remain committed to the current path until we see a sustained decline in food price volatility and a clearer convergence of headline inflation toward the target.
